result.instructions: Tools for Beds24, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Beds24 data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run beds24_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run beds24_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run beds24_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. beds24_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: beds24_get_token_details
tools.title: Get token details
tools.description: Check the configured Beds24 token: whether it is valid, its scopes, owner id, expiry, and whether it is restricted to one property. A cheap way to confirm setup and see which scopes are granted. Note Beds24 answers HTTP 200 with validToken=false for a bad token. Beds24: GET /authentication/details.

tools.name: beds24_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the properties in the account with their address, currency, check-in times and room types (roomTypes). Optional flags include texts, pictures, offers, unit details and all rooms. Requires the properties scope. Beds24: GET /properties.

includeAllRooms.description: Include every room type of each property.

includeUnitDetails.description: Include full unit details (by default only unit names).

page.description: Page number beyond the first (2, 3, ...). Check pages.nextPageExists in the previous response.

tools.name: beds24_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: Search bookings by arrival/departure date range, booking or modified time, property, room, channel, status, or a free-text search over guest name, email, booking id and API reference. With NO filters Beds24 returns only upcoming bookings. `filter` shortcuts: arrivals (arriving today), departures (departing today), new (created in the last 24h), current (in-house). Guest data needs the bookings-personal scope, invoice items bookings-financial. Beds24: GET /bookings.

masterIds.description: One or more group master booking ids.

status.description: Statuses to include. Defaults to all except cancelled.

searchString.description: Matches guest name, email, apiReference or booking id.

page.description: Page number beyond the first (2, 3, ...). Check pages.nextPageExists in the previous response.

tools.name: beds24_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Fetch one booking by id with its invoice items, info items and additional guests. Works for any status, including cancelled. Beds24: GET /bookings?id=<id>.

tools.name: beds24_list_booking_messages
tools.title: List booking messages
tools.description: Read the guest conversation on bookings — messages from guests, host replies, internal notes and system messages — across channels (Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, direct). Filter by booking, property, room, read/unread, source and age. Beds24: GET /bookings/messages.

masterIds.description: One or more group master booking ids.

maxAge.description: Only messages from the last N days.

page.description: Page number beyond the first (2, 3, ...). Check pages.nextPageExists in the previous response.

tools.name: beds24_list_booking_invoices
tools.title: List booking invoices
tools.description: List invoices and their line items (charges and payments) for bookings. Requires the bookings-financial scope. Beds24 marks this endpoint Alpha. Beds24: GET /bookings/invoices.

page.description: Page number beyond the first (2, 3, ...). Check pages.nextPageExists in the previous response.

tools.name: beds24_get_room_offers
tools.title: Get room offers (quote)
tools.description: Quote a stay: bookable offers with total price and units available per room for given dates and guests. Use before creating a booking. Beds24: GET /inventory/rooms/offers.

includeTexts.description: Include descriptive texts in these 2-letter languages, e.g. ["en"].

page.description: Page number beyond the first (2, 3, ...). Check pages.nextPageExists in the previous response.

tools.name: beds24_get_room_availability
tools.title: Get room availability
tools.description: Per-date availability (true/false) for rooms over a range of nights. endDate is the LAST NIGHT (the day before check-out). Beds24: GET /inventory/rooms/availability.

page.description: Page number beyond the first (2, 3, ...). Check pages.nextPageExists in the previous response.

tools.name: beds24_get_unit_bookings
tools.title: Get unit bookings (occupancy grid)
tools.description: Which units of each room type are booked on each date — an occupancy grid keyed by date. endDate is the last night. Beds24 marks this endpoint Beta. Beds24: GET /inventory/rooms/unitBookings.

page.description: Page number beyond the first (2, 3, ...). Check pages.nextPageExists in the previous response.

tools.name: beds24_get_room_calendar
tools.title: Get room calendar
tools.description: Per-day calendar values for rooms: units available, min/max stay, multiplier, override (blackout, no check-in, ...) and the price slots price1..price16, as date ranges. Choose fields with the include flags; if none are set this tool asks for numAvail, minStay, maxStay, override and prices. Beds24: GET /inventory/rooms/calendar.

page.description: Page number beyond the first (2, 3, ...). Check pages.nextPageExists in the previous response.

tools.name: beds24_list_fixed_prices
tools.title: List fixed prices
tools.description: List fixed price rules (seasonal rates): date span, min/max nights, per-room and per-person prices, discounts, allowed arrival days and channel export. Beds24: GET /inventory/fixedPrices.

fixedPriceIds.description: One or more fixed price ids.

page.description: Page number beyond the first (2, 3, ...). Check pages.nextPageExists in the previous response.

tools.name: beds24_list_booking_com_reviews
tools.title: List Booking.com reviews
tools.description: Guest reviews from Booking.com for one property, made on or after a date: scores, content, reviewer and any reply. At most 100 per call. Beds24 marks this endpoint Alpha. Beds24: GET /channels/booking/reviews.

from.description: Reviews made on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: beds24_list_airbnb_reviews
tools.title: List Airbnb reviews
tools.description: Guest reviews from Airbnb for one room: overall and category ratings, public review, private feedback and the host response. At most 100 per call. Beds24 marks this endpoint Beta. Beds24: GET /channels/airbnb/reviews.

roomId.description: The Beds24 room id linked to the Airbnb listing.

tools.name: beds24_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: Create a new booking in a room for given dates and guest details. It immediately blocks inventory and is synced to connected channels. Set checkAvailability=true to refuse the booking if the room is not free, and notifyGuest / notifyHost to send confirmation emails. Undo by setting status cancelled with beds24_update_booking. Requires a token with bookings write access. Beds24: POST /bookings.

unitId.description: Specific unit within the room type.

flagColor.description: Flag colour, 6-character hex (e.g. ff0000) or empty string to clear.

checkAvailability.description: Do not save the booking if the room has no availability. Recommended.

assignBooking.description: Let Beds24 assign the first free unit / room using room dependency settings.

notifyGuest.description: Email the guest a booking confirmation.

notifyHost.description: Email the host a booking confirmation.

tools.name: beds24_update_booking
tools.title: Update a booking
tools.description: Change an existing booking: dates, room/unit, guest counts, guest details, notes, flag, price, or status (e.g. confirmed, or cancelled to cancel — reversible by setting it back). Only the fields you pass change. Optionally add info items (code/text pairs). Changes sync to channels where allowed. Beds24: POST /bookings with the booking id.

unitId.description: Specific unit within the room type.

flagColor.description: Flag colour, 6-character hex (e.g. ff0000) or empty string to clear.

addInfoItems.description: Info items to ADD to the booking (existing ones are untouched).

notifyGuest.description: Email the guest an updated confirmation.

tools.name: beds24_send_booking_message
tools.title: Send a booking message
tools.description: Send a message on a booking's conversation. With source host (default) it is delivered to the GUEST through their channel (Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, email) and cannot be unsent; with source internalNote it is a private host note. Beds24: POST /bookings/messages.

source.description: host (to the guest, default) or internalNote (private).

tools.name: beds24_mark_messages_read
tools.title: Mark messages read
tools.description: Mark one or more booking messages as read (or unread with read=false). Beds24: POST /bookings/messages with [{ id, read }].

tools.name: beds24_update_room_calendar
tools.title: Update room calendar
tools.description: Set per-day calendar values for ONE room over a date range: units available (numAvail), minStay, maxStay, multiplier, override (none, blackout, exception, noCheckIn, noCheckOut, noCheckInOrCheckOut) and price slots price1..price16. Set a price to null to remove it. These values sync to channels. Read the current values first with beds24_get_room_calendar so you can restore them. Beds24: POST /inventory/rooms/calendar.
